title: S32 — Adaptive thresholding: replace single otsu with local-adaptive for corrosion/collage families
desc: Current pipeline uses global otsu for binarization. On corrosion (pitted glyphs, non-uniform ink) and collage (rotated cards with varying background), global thresholding loses faint strokes or picks up noise. Method: (1) implement local-adaptive thresholding (Bradley or Sauvola) in a separate tool; (2) run on the 6 collapse families' images; (3) measure per-family segmentation quality improvement; (4) if improvement, wire into reader pipeline and re-bench both suites. Owner: barry. Priority: 2. Parent: t-20261011-88dc.
